sql.availability.getAllForResource: SELECT rs.id, rs.org_id, rs.user_id, rs.start_date, rs.end_date, rs.archived, rs.company_id, ( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(d))) FROM ( select rsa.id, rsa.resource_schedule_id as "resourceScheduleId", dow.id as "dayOfWeekId", dow.day_of_week as "dayOfWeek", rsa.start_time as "startTime", rsa.end_time as "endTime", coalesce(rsa.archived, false) as archived from flow.day_of_week dow left join flow.resource_schedule_availability rsa on rsa.day_of_week_id = dow.id and rsa.resource_schedule_id = rs.id order by dow.id < (select day_of_week_id from flow.company_week_start where company_id = :companyId), "dayOfWeekId") d ) as resource_schedule_availability FROM flow.resource_schedule rs LEFT JOIN flow.org o ON o.id = rs.org_id LEFT JOIN flow.user u ON u.id = rs.org_id WHERE case when :orgId::int is not null then rs.org_id = :orgId else rs.user_id = :userId end and rs.company_id = :companyId and rs.archived is not true and (rs.end_date is null OR rs.end_date > now() - interval '30 days') order by rs.start_date
sql.availability.getWorkDays: select dow.*, (select day_of_week_id from flow.company_week_start where company_id = :companyId) as company_week_start_day_of_week_id from flow.day_of_week dow order by dow.id < (select day_of_week_id from flow.company_week_start where company_id = :companyId), id
sql.availability.updateSchedule: update flow.resource_schedule set start_date = :startDate, end_date = :endDate, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :modifiedById where id = :id
sql.availability.updateScheduleWithoutEndDat: update flow.resource_schedule set end_date = :startDate::date - interval '1 day', date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :modifiedById where case when user_id::int is not null then user_id::int = :userId else org_id::int = :orgId end and company_id = :companyId and archived is not true and end_date is null and id != :id
sql.availability.deleteSchedule: update flow.resource_schedule set archived = true, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :modifiedById where id = :id
sql.availability.insertSchedule: insert into flow.resource_schedule(company_id, user_id, org_id, start_date, end_date, created_by_id) values (:companyId, :userId, :orgId, :startDate, :endDate, :createdById)
sql.availability.getOne: SELECT rs.id, rs.org_id, rs.start_date, rs.end_date, rs.company_id, ( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(d))) FROM ( select rsa.id, rsa.resource_schedule_id as "resourceScheduleId", dow.id as "dayOfWeekId", dow.day_of_week as "dayOfWeek", rsa.start_time as "startTime", rsa.end_time as "endTime", coalesce(rsa.archived, false) as archived from flow.day_of_week dow left join flow.resource_schedule_availability rsa on rsa.day_of_week_id = dow.id and rsa.resource_schedule_id = rs.id order by dow.id < (select day_of_week_id from flow.company_week_start where company_id = :companyId), "dayOfWeekId") d ) as resource_schedule_availability FROM flow.resource_schedule rs LEFT JOIN flow.org o ON o.id = rs.org_id LEFT JOIN flow.user u ON u.id = rs.org_id WHERE rs.id = :id
sql.availability.updateHours: update flow.resource_schedule_availability set start_time = :startTime::time, end_time = :endTime::time, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now(), archived = :archived where id = :id
sql.availability.insertHours: insert into flow.resource_schedule_availability(resource_schedule_id, start_time, end_time, day_of_week_id, created_by_id) values (:resourceScheduleId, :startTime::time, :endTime::time, :dayOfWeekId, :createdById)
sql.availability.updateAppointment: update flow.resource_appointment set start_time = :startTime::timestamp, end_time = :endTime::timestamp, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now(), all_day = :allDay, description = :description, recurrence = :recurrence, recurring_start_time = :recurringStartTime, recurring_end_time = :recurringEndTime where id = :id
sql.availability.insertAppointment: insert into flow.resource_appointment(company_id, user_id, org_id, start_time, end_time, created_by_id, all_day, description, recurrence, recurring_start_time, recurring_end_time) values (:companyId, :userId, :orgId, :startTime::timestamp, :endTime::timestamp, :createdById, :allDay, :description, :recurrence, now(), :recurringEndTime)
sql.availability.getAppointment: SELECT ra.id, ra.org_id, ra.start_time, ra.end_time, ra.company_id, ra.archived, ra.description, ra.all_day, ra.recurrence, case when ra.recurrence is not null then true else false end as repeat, ra.recurring_start_time as "recurringStartTime", ra.recurring_end_time as "recurringEndTime" FROM flow.resource_appointment ra LEFT JOIN flow.org o ON o.id = ra.org_id LEFT JOIN flow.user u ON u.id = ra.org_id WHERE ra.id = :id
sql.availability.getAppointmentsForResource: SELECT ra.id, ra.org_id, ra.start_time, case when ra.recurrence is not null then true else false end as repeat, ra.end_time, ra.archived, ra.description, ra.company_id, ra.all_day, ra.recurrence, ra.recurring_start_time as "recurringStartTime", ra.recurring_end_time as "recurringEndTime" FROM flow.resource_appointment ra LEFT JOIN flow.org o ON o.id = ra.org_id LEFT JOIN flow.user u ON u.id = ra.user_id WHERE case when :orgId::int is not null then ra.org_id = :orgId else ra.user_id = :userId end and ra.company_id = :companyId and ra.archived is not true and (ra.start_time >= (now() - '7 days'::interval) OR ra.end_time >= (now() - '7 days'::interval)) order by ra.start_time, ra.end_time, ra.all_day limit :limit offset :offset
sql.availability.getAppointmentsForResourceC: SELECT count (*) FROM flow.resource_appointment ra LEFT JOIN flow.org o ON o.id = ra.org_id LEFT JOIN flow.user u ON u.id = ra.user_id WHERE case when :orgId::int is not null then ra.org_id = :orgId else ra.user_id = :userId end and ra.company_id = :companyId and ra.archived is not true and (ra.start_time >= (now() - '7 days'::interval) OR ra.end_time >= (now() - '7 days'::interval))
sql.availability.deleteAppointment: update flow.resource_appointment set modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now(), archived = true where id = :id
sql.availability.getUserAppointmentLength: select default_appointment_length from flow.user_company where user_id = :userId and company_id = :companyId
sql.availability.getOrgAppointmentLength: select default_appointment_length from flow.org where id = :orgId
sql.availability.saveUserAppointmentLength: update flow.user_company set default_appointment_length = :appointmentLength where user_id = :userId and company_id = :companyId
sql.availability.saveOrgAppointmentLength: update flow.org set default_appointment_length = :appointmentLength where id = :orgId
sql.availability.getTimeSlots: select scheduled_start_time, array_to_json(users) as users from flow.get_availability_time_slots(:projectId::int, :startTime::timestamp, :endTime::timestamp, :availableDate::date)
